items.snippet:
Robot S1 Pro's map is lost
1. Check the map management page for the corresponding map.
2. Restart the robot and attempt to remap the house to see if the map loss issue persists.
3. The map data will be removed when the red function button is pressed then hold for over 5 seconds. In this case, you will need to re-map the entire house before use.

What should I do if my S1 Pro/T2080 positioning failed or cannot saved a map?
1.Relocate the base station to an area with richer map features and rebuild the map, allowing robot to start working from an initial point with map features. 2.Add some obstacles, such as cardboard boxes, that are taller than the machine near the base station to serve as map features.
